refusals.shown_in_the_pitch: extract the residual contrast-enhancing surgical cavity wall from a real post-operative T1-contrast MRI
refusals.why_refused: no post-operative imaging is cached: the committed BraTS-2021 release is pre-operative only (six cases, one timepoint each; recorded in data/tcia_probe/multimodal_evidence.json), so a resection cavity cannot be extracted and the word 'cavity' is not used for what was planted
refusals.what_is_recorded_instead: the planted field uses the PRE-OPERATIVE tumour rim of the expert segmentation (BraTS2021_01017); the substitution is named in the record

refusals.shown_in_the_pitch: 'inject synthetic fluorescence intensity values ... to simulate a digitized 5-ALA camera readout'
refusals.why_refused: a field manufactured here and read back here proves the intake path works; it cannot show that real 5-ALA maps look like the planted construction, that fluorescence marks tumour, or that any mock-up volume (e.g. 0.42 cm3 residual) is recoverable
refusals.what_is_recorded_instead: the intake identity on the real geometry, the matched-burden layout contrast under MTD, and the decay-length sweep -- every entry labelled synthetic

refusals.shown_in_the_pitch: DSC perfusion maps from Ivy GAP or CPTAC-3
refusals.why_refused: the repository's measured DSC perfusion is UPENN-GBM (456 patients with DSC series; three series downloaded and read), and Ivy GAP / CPTAC-3 are not probed here -- naming them would misdescribe what was measured

available to read is not acquirable: MU-Glioma-Post documents 203 subjects / 596 post-treatment timepoints with the images behind a licence login, and the probe returns 0 patients and 0 segmentation series; the CFB-GBM manifest enumerates 393 usable T1-Gd pairs over 168 patients and 0 images are downloaded
refusals.what_is_recorded_instead: the live census in danon/walkforward.py and the manifest counts; 0 scorable pairs

refusals.shown_in_the_pitch: GLASS Consortium for sub-clone resistance shifts
refusals.why_refused: the clone-SIZE step, not the data: the GLASS release IS measured in this tree now (danon.variants; the live counts are read back in the walk-forward census rather than restated here), and the engine carries exactly two bins -- sensitive and resistant -- so a k-bin allele-frequency spectrum would still need a summarisation rule this repository does not have, while a point clone fraction and an upper bound need a purity and a copy number the release does not carry
refusals.what_is_recorded_instead: the walk-forward census's GLASS entry, its variant_channel block and danon/variants' own refusals

refusals.shown_in_the_pitch: pathology WSI: 'trains and tests nuclear cell packing algorithms on real digitized H&E slides'
refusals.why_refused: one slide is cached and it is haematoxylin-only; it yields a real measured cell DENSITY, which is not a proliferation index, and it cannot support a Ki-67 ratio; training a packing model would need labelled nuclei across more than one slide
refusals.what_is_recorded_instead: the measured cellularity and the refused Ki-67 route in danon/histology.py via clinical_twin.clinical_stream_census()

notes: the planted fluorescence field is manufactured by this repository and is not a measured 5-ALA acquisition
planted on the PRE-OPERATIVE tumour rim of BraTS2021_01017: no post-operative imaging is cached, so no resection cavity exists to plant on (the pitch's step 1 cannot be run as written)
the engine grid is (14, 24, 24) at 3.634 mm/voxel (1774 tumour voxels); the decay length is declared in voxels and its sweep is recorded rather than tuned

the case is a SHELL, not a ball: mean distance from the boundary is 1.07 voxels for every planted mode, so the three fluorescence layouts are nearly the same field (their day-365 medians agree to 0.014%, and 2.50 burden units separate them at day 60); the layout contrast is therefore recorded as INERT ON THIS CASE rather than presented as a measured sensitivity

what does move the endpoints is the resistant-clone layout: the engine's clustered R patch versus the stream's uniform r0 gives a paired median burden delta of +1291.66 at day 365, so the stream's clonal placement dominates its fluorophore pattern on this case -- a finding about this model's initial condition, not about 5-ALA
what this can show: the intake identity, whether a supplied seed changes the trajectory, and where the change comes from
what this cannot show: that a real 5-ALA map resembles the planted field, that fluorescence marks tumour, or anything about a patient
what_a_synthetic_input_cannot_show: that real 5-ALA fluorescence fields resemble any planted construction here: no capture is cached, and the constructions were chosen for contrast, not fitted to data
that fluorescence marks tumour: that is the biological claim, and a planted field assumes it rather than testing it
that a residual volume could be recovered from a real capture: the standard supplies the volume by construction
anything about a patient: the case is one de-identified BraTS-2021 segmentation and every field on it is synthetic
